# Vendored libraries

Plain copies of the published dist files — no build step, no CDN at runtime.
To update: download the package tarball from the npm registry and copy the
same files across.

| File | Package | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js`, `SplitText.min.js`, `Flip.min.js`, `CustomEase.min.js` | gsap 3.15.0 | GreenSock Standard "no charge" licence — free for commercial use, including the former Club plugins, since 3.13 (2025). https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `lenis.min.js` | lenis 1.3.26 | MIT, © 2024 darkroom.engineering. `sourceMappingURL` comment stripped (the map is not shipped). |

The Lenis stylesheet rules live in `assets/motion.css`, not as a separate file.
